import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
v,s,b,t,copy,check=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
verdict=json.loads(v.read_text())
assert sha(s)==verdict['source_check']['sha256']
assert sha(t)==verdict['terms_sha256']
assert sha(b)=='4cee3926dc77603d5ccf27a8340efea336067c5b4fa1fee70b00d95f88a66159'
r,=[r for r in json.loads(s.read_text())['releases'] if r['id']=='104449-2026' and r['ocid']=='ocds-h6vhtk-07971f' and 'tender' in r['tag']]
lot,=[lot for lot in r['tender']['lots'] if lot['id']=='LOT-0000']
weights=[(c['name'],n['number'],n['weight']) for c in lot['awardCriteria']['criteria'] for n in c['numbers']]
assert weights==[('Price',5,'percentageExact'),('Quality',85,'percentageExact'),('Social Value',10,'percentageExact')]
edits={
'The saved structured record does not establish eligibility or award criteria.':'The notice publishes these award weights for LOT-0000: Price 5%, Quality 85%, and Social Value 10%. Check the tender pack for detailed scoring and eligibility requirements.',
'Les données structurées enregistrées ne permettent pas d’établir les conditions d’admissibilité ni les critères d’attribution.':'L’avis publie les pondérations suivantes pour l’attribution du lot LOT-0000 : prix 5 %, qualité 85 % et valeur sociale 10 %. Consultez le dossier de consultation pour connaître les modalités détaillées de notation et les conditions d’admissibilité.'}
original=b.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
revised=original
for old,new in edits.items():
    assert revised.count(old)==1
    revised=revised.replace(old,new)
restored=revised
for old,new in edits.items():
    assert restored.count(new)==1
    restored=restored.replace(new,old)
assert restored==original
copy.write_text(revised,encoding='utf-8')
assert copy.read_text(encoding='utf-8')==revised
report={'release':r['id'],'ocid':r['ocid'],'lot':lot['id'],'criteria':weights,'checks':{'source_and_terms_hashes_match':True,'two_sentence_replacement_only':True,'saved_copy_matches':True},'sha256':{str(p):sha(p) for p in (s,t,b,copy)},'scope':'Offline fictional rehearsal. Detailed scoring, eligibility, case-local source inclusion and delivery remain unverified.'}
check.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(check.read_text())==json.loads(json.dumps(report))
print(check.read_text())
